exit_rules: Hard stop 2.5 ATR (daily ATR14). After +1.5 ATR in our favour the stop moves to breakeven (+0.1 ATR) and then trails 4 ATR behind the best price. After any stop exit, no same-side re-entry until the traders' consensus goes flat/flips (max 72h). Perp shorts hedged by the trader's own spot holdings (≥50%) are ignored.
